name: Ikoyi Skyline Penthouse
summary: A dramatic three-bedroom penthouse with floor-to-ceiling views over the Lagos skyline.
description: Rich charcoal walls, layered lighting and a sculptural upholstered bed set the tone in this top-floor residence. The open-plan living and dining space flows onto a private terrace, and every bedroom has its own en-suite bathroom.

images.alt: Master bedroom with charcoal walls, a white channel-tufted bed and city views
Open-plan living room with a white sofa and timber feature wall
Double-height lounge with a timber staircase and blue cushions
Grey living room with a round coffee table and black shelving
